Title: Kunal's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Kunal - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Meenakshi - 34 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Vimla - 73 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Pihu - 9 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Kunal stands by the road. Meenakshi and Pihu stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Kunal, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal rides his bicycle down the road.]

Kunal: "Yes, all right."

[Kunal gets into the car.]

Pihu: "Mom, listen!"

[Kunal gets on the bus.]

Kunal (surprised): "This is amazing!"

[Kunal gets off the school bus.]

Kunal: "Pihu, are you okay?"

[Kunal hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Kunal (excited): "This is amazing!"

[Kunal pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Kunal (excited): "What a day to remember!"
